comment: Independent teleport.c level_tele() witness for the confused random arm inside the Quest. A debug-mode Priest teleports to Pri-loca through the level menu (letter z on this seed's second page), drinks a wished-for potion of confusion, searches once, and asks ^V for level 3. Confusion && rnl(5) prints 'Oops...' and jumps to random_levtport, whose random_teleport_level() returns an absolute depth; C skips the typed-level quest adjustment (newlev + depth_start - 1) on that path, so the hero moves from Home 3 to Home 2 instead of to the goal level.
